units.source_text: 于是每逢感触，不胜伤心，似觉身患疾病，异常痛苦，

en.t: So whenever something stirred his feelings, he was overcome with grief, as if he had fallen ill, and suffered terribly,

units.source_text: 心中反复思量：“母亲不惜盛年的花容月貌，改装成了朴陋的尼僧姿态。

en.t: and he turned it over again and again in his heart: "Mother cast aside the flower-like beauty of her prime and changed herself into the plain, humble form of a nun.

units.source_text: 究竟由于何等坚强的道心，而突然遁入空门呢？

en.t: What depth of steadfast religious resolve could have made her suddenly enter the Buddhist life?

units.source_text: 想必是像我幼时所闻：身逢意外之变，因而愤世出家的吧。

en.t: Surely it must be as I heard when I was young: she met with some unexpected calamity and, in anger at the world, took the tonsure.

units.source_text: 此种大事，难道不会走漏消息么？

en.t: Could news of such a great matter really have failed to leak out?

units.source_text: 只因不便出之于口，所以无人向我告知吧。”

en.t: It must only be because it was awkward to speak of that no one told me."

units.source_text: 又想：“母亲虽然朝夕勤修佛法，但女人的悟力毕竟薄弱，要深通佛道，往生极乐，恐是难能之事。

en.t: Then he thought again: "Although Mother practices the Buddhist law diligently morning and evening, a woman's capacity for enlightenment is, after all, weak; to understand the Buddhist way deeply and be reborn in paradise may be very difficult.

units.source_text: 何况女人又有五障，也很可担心。

en.t: Moreover, women bear the five hindrances, which is also a grave cause for worry.

units.source_text: 故我应该帮助母亲成全其志，至少使她后世安乐。”

en.t: Therefore I should help Mother fulfill her wish, and at least make her next life peaceful."

units.source_text: 又推想那个已过的人，恐怕也是怀着畏罪之心，抱恨而死的吧。

en.t: He also imagined that the one who had passed away must have died harboring resentment and a fear of sin.

units.source_text: 他希望后世总得和这生身父亲相见，便无心在这世间举行冠礼。

en.t: Hoping that in a future life he might finally meet this true father of his, he had no heart to hold his coming-of-age ceremony in this world.
In the end, however, he could not refuse.

units.source_text: 不久自然闻名于世，声势煊赫了。

en.t: Before long, he naturally became renowned throughout the world, and his prestige grew dazzlingly great.

units.source_text: 但他对于现世荣华毫不关心，一向只是沉思默想。

en.t: But he cared nothing for worldly glory, and remained always sunk in silent thought.
